global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, golden broth with delicate swirls of green onion. Toppings—nori, chashu, menma, and naruto—are artfully arranged in a blue-and-white ceramic bowl, set against warm wooden tones under soft, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with smooth texture and subtle natural wood texture details.
regions.bowl: Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate floral pattern, glossy finish, and raised decorative rim.
regions.soup: The broth with noodles shows golden-brown, glossy, viscous liquid swirling around pale noodles and green onions.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, crinkled, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly glossy, textured surface.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a pinkish-brown slice with visible fat marbling, seasoned with black pepper, and has a slightly glistening surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a fibrous texture and visible seasoning specks on their surface.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale yellow, circular, with pinkish center ring, slightly irregular edges, smooth surface.
